## Scientific readiness — updated 2026-11-02

Read [Choosing corrections](docs/concepts/correction-eligibility.md) before execution. Spatial validity does not
establish physical calibration. Gordon/Goldhill/Ruby physical units remain
unverified; their current mosaic BRDF fits are unsupported and topographic
outputs are diagnostic only. A requested unsupported stage blocks completion.
A successful historical run, merged table or upload is not scientific approval.
Do not infer reflectance from 10k names or assign nadir views to unblock BRDF.

# Historical example path (review the source before use):
# spectralbridge/summer-2023-10cm-10k/SPR2-06-28-23-ExportPackage/NEON_D13_NIWO_test_aligned_orthomosaic.h5

from pathlib import Path
from pprint import pprint

from spectralbridge import run_drone_pipeline

# Point this at the top-level folder you copied into the repo.
# The drone pipeline will recursively find every .h5 file in nested subfolders.
input_h5_dir = Path("summer-2023-10cm-10k")
polygon_path = Path("Datasets/niwot_aop_polygons_2023_12_8_23_analysis_ready_half_diam.gpkg")
output_dir = Path("drone_outputs") / "drone_pipeline"

# One independently calibrated and spatially validated flight per call.
RUN = False
if RUN:
    import json
    calibration = json.loads(Path("reviewed_flight_calibration.json").read_text())
    results = run_drone_pipeline(
        input_h5_dir=input_h5_dir,
        polygon_path=polygon_path,
        output_dir=output_dir,
        radiometry=calibration,
        apply_topo=False,
        apply_brdf=False,
        apply_translation=False,
        drone_manifest_path="Drone Field Data Macrosystems - UAS Data Processing For Extraction.csv",
    )
    pprint(results)
else:
    print("Review source alignment, calibration and correction eligibility before setting RUN=True.")
